One honest agent risks 95 POA once; a farm of 654 risks 62130 POA, and one failed proof forfeits the lot. The pigment is the evidence, the wharf is the expense, and the inlet is the expiry that forces the farm to pay again. The mechanism is old, the price is honest, and the record is open to all.
